notes:
A condition Crisp cannot check no longer changes what it does.

Ask for something like "if the audio is noisy, trim it to 10 seconds" and Crisp used to hear the words in your condition instead of your actual request — it ran an audio job and lost the trim completely. It now separates the two, so the edit you asked for is the edit you get. Conditions Crisp cannot measure still go ahead as before, and it tells you so. On a photo, where there is no length or sound to check, it now says that too rather than quietly acting.
